lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is Wednesday's Parks & Rec Commission meeting, where the already-approved plan to pave Town Park's grass oval for basketball and pickleball courts comes back up — more than 400 signatures and letters in opposition make this one worth watching. Elsewhere, TMVOA's board meets Thursday to vote on officer elections and proposed amendments to its fiscal policies, and the San Miguel Basin Fair and Rodeo kicks off Friday alongside the New York Philharmonic Brass Quintet as part of the summer music run.
